_scene: FR — INT. FRONT ROOM, Act One 1:25–3:15. Re-cut 2026-08-14 for dialogue rhythm: the camera cuts between speaker and listener rather than parking on one face. Julian: 'it needs tom then cut to richard then back to tom'.
_rooms: Counter rear right. Tom camera-left of it, Richard camera-right behind it. Screen direction never crossed.

shots.establish: A wide view of an antique shop interior. A man in a navy hooded parka stands on the customer side of a wooden counter holding a bundle wrapped in cream checked cloth in both hands at chest height. An old man with white hair, a white beard and round glasses stands behind the counter in a green waistcoat and rolled shirtsleeves, no apron. A ginger cat sits upright on the counter.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The man in the navy parka
silent: The old man behind the counter
shots.open: the man in the parka standing a pace back from the counter, the wrapped bundle held away from his body, looking at the old man.
shots.event: he speaks to the old man across the counter, his eyebrows lifting slightly on the question, weight shifting once from one foot to the other.
shots.end: the man in the parka still holding the bundle, still looking at the old man, waiting for an answer. The cat has not moved.
shots.hold: The bundle stays wrapped and tied. No box is visible anywhere in the frame.

shots.establish: Closer on the old man behind the wooden counter: white hair, white beard, round gold glasses, green waistcoat over rolled white shirtsleeves, both hands resting flat on the counter top. A ginger cat sits beside him. At the frame edge nearest him, a small open walnut box.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The old man
shots.open: the old man looking off to his left, palms flat on the counter.
shots.event: he speaks one short line, the corner of his mouth lifting a fraction at the end of it, the faintest dry amusement, his eyes never leaving the person off-screen to his left.
shots.end: the old man still, hands flat, the small lift at the corner of his mouth settling.
shots.hold: He wears no apron of any kind.

shots.establish: Close on a shop counter. A small worn walnut music box stands open on a folded cream checked cloth, brass cylinder and steel comb inside. A man's two hands rest on the cloth either side of it, navy jacket cuffs and rust-red knitted sleeves. A small brass key lies on the cloth.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.open: both hands resting on the cloth either side of the open box, still.
shots.event: the fingers of both hands settle the box a fraction straighter on the cloth, then withdraw slowly to the edge of the frame, the fingertips leaving last.
shots.end: the box alone on the open cloth, both hands gone from the frame, the brass key lying beside it. Nothing moves.
shots.hold: No face appears at any point. Only two hands are ever in this frame.

shots.establish: Chest-up on a man in his forties in a navy hooded parka over a rust-red crewneck jumper over a grey checked collar, short dark hair greying at the temples. Behind him, glass cabinets of brass and glass objects in a warm shop interior. In the lower corner of the frame, the edge of a wooden counter and a small open walnut box on a checked cloth.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The man in the navy parka
shots.open: the man looking down at the small box on the counter below him.
shots.event: he begins to speak, still looking down at the box rather than up at anyone. Partway through he swallows once, and his eyes come up for a moment to the person off-screen to his right, then go back down to the box.
shots.end: the man looking down at the box again, mouth closing on the last word, jaw tight.

shots.establish: Closer on the old man behind the wooden counter: white hair, white beard, round gold glasses, green waistcoat over rolled shirtsleeves, both palms flat on the counter top. A ginger cat beside him. At the frame edge, a small open walnut box.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
silent: The old man
shots.open: the old man looking off to his left, both palms flat and still on the counter.
shots.event: his head tilts a quarter-inch to one side and stops there. His eyebrows draw very slightly together. He blinks once, slowly.
shots.end: the old man motionless, head still tilted, both hands flat on the counter, eyes steady on the person off-screen.
shots.hold: He wears no apron of any kind.

shots.establish: Chest-up on the man in the navy parka over a rust-red jumper over a grey checked collar, short dark hair greying at the temples, in a warm shop interior. In the lower corner of the frame, the edge of a wooden counter and a small open walnut box on a checked cloth.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The man in the navy parka
shots.open: the man looking down at the box, jaw tight.
shots.event: he speaks again, shorter this time, and on the last word his hand comes into the bottom of the frame and reaches toward the small brass key at the back of the box.
shots.end: the man's hand at the box, fingers on the brass key, his eyes down on it, mouth closed.

shots.establish: A group at a shop counter: a very small girl with two dark braids in blue overalls and a striped shirt at the counter edge, a boy in a brown jumper with an open notebook beside her, a girl in a green cardigan behind them, a taller girl with a long red braid and a green field jacket furthest back with folded arms. Beyond the counter an old man with white hair and round glasses in a green waistcoat, no apron, and a man in a navy parka.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The very small girl with dark braids
silent: The boy in the brown jumper
The girl in the green cardigan
The girl with the red braid
The old man
The man in the navy parka
shots.open: the small girl up on her toes with both hands gripping the counter edge, chin barely clearing it.
shots.event: she says something short and delighted, bouncing once on her toes as she says it, both hands still gripping the counter.
shots.end: the small girl grinning, still on her toes, looking at the box. Nobody else has moved.

shots.establish: A group at a shop counter: a very small girl with two dark braids in blue overalls at the counter edge, a boy in a brown jumper with an open notebook and a pencil beside her, a girl in a green cardigan behind them, a taller girl with a long red braid furthest back with folded arms. Beyond the counter an old man with white hair and round glasses in a green waistcoat, no apron, and a man in a navy parka.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The boy in the brown jumper
silent: The very small girl with dark braids
The girl in the green cardigan
The girl with the red braid
The old man
The man in the navy parka
shots.open: the boy with his notebook open, pencil already touching the page, eyes on the box.
shots.event: he speaks quickly and precisely while his pencil keeps moving on the page, and twice he points the pencil tip briefly at the box without looking up.
shots.end: the boy's pencil stopped mid-page, his eyes still on the box, mouth closing.
shots.hold: The boy in the brown jumper wears no glasses. Only the old man wears glasses.

shots.establish: A group at a shop counter: a very small girl with dark braids at the counter edge, a boy in a brown jumper with a notebook, a girl in a green cardigan with strawberry-blonde hair and a floral dress standing a little back, a taller girl with a long red braid furthest back. Beyond the counter an old man with white hair and round glasses, no apron, and a man in a navy parka.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The girl in the green cardigan
silent: The very small girl with dark braids
The boy in the brown jumper
The girl with the red braid
The old man
The man in the navy parka
shots.open: the girl in the green cardigan looking not at the mechanism but at the lid of the box, her head slightly lowered.
shots.event: she speaks quietly, and as she does she lifts one hand and almost touches the lid of the box, stopping just short of it.
shots.end: her hand still hovering just above the lid, not touching it, her eyes on the worn place in the wood.

shots.establish: Chest-up on the man in the navy parka over a rust-red jumper over a grey checked collar, short dark hair greying at the temples, in a warm shop interior. In the lower corner of the frame, the edge of a wooden counter and a small open walnut box.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The man in the navy parka
shots.open: the man looking down at the box.
shots.event: he speaks, listing something, and one hand comes up and turns over briefly, palm open, a small helpless gesture before it drops out of frame again.
shots.end: the man's hand gone from frame, his eyes back down on the box, mouth closing.

shots.establish: Closer on the old man behind the wooden counter: white hair, white beard, round gold glasses, green waistcoat over rolled shirtsleeves, both palms flat on the counter. A ginger cat beside him. At the frame edge, a small open walnut box.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
silent: The old man
shots.open: the old man looking off to his left, hands flat on the counter.
shots.event: his eyes travel down and to the side, coming to rest on the open walnut box at the edge of the frame. His jaw sets very slightly.
shots.end: the old man looking down at the box, hands still flat, completely still.
shots.hold: He wears no apron of any kind.

shots.establish: Chest-up on the man in the navy parka over a rust-red jumper over a grey checked collar, in a warm shop interior. In the lower corner of the frame, the edge of a wooden counter and a small open walnut box.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The man in the navy parka
shots.open: the man looking down at the box.
shots.event: he speaks more quietly than before, his head lowering slightly as he does, and near the end he shakes his head once, very small.
shots.end: the man's head still lowered, eyes down, mouth closed, shoulders dropped.

shots.establish: The old man behind the shop counter, now wearing a brown leather work apron over his green waistcoat and rolled shirtsleeves. White hair, white beard, round gold glasses. On the counter in front of him a small open walnut music box on a folded cream checked cloth. Four children stand beyond the counter, and a man in a navy parka.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
silent: The old man
The four children
The man in the navy parka
shots.open: the old man with both hands at the top of his apron front, the apron already over his head and tied behind him.
shots.event: both his flat palms smooth down the front of the apron from chest to waist in one slow settled motion, like a knight settling armour. His eyes go down to the music box. He does not touch it.
shots.then: he stops completely and stands entirely still, hands resting at the bottom of the apron, eyes on the box.
shots.end: the old man motionless in his apron, both hands still, looking down at the box he has not touched. The children watching him. Nothing moves.

shots.establish: Closer on the old man behind the wooden counter, wearing a brown leather work apron over a green waistcoat and rolled shirtsleeves, white hair, white beard, round gold glasses. A ginger cat beside him. At the frame edge, a small open walnut box.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The old man
shots.open: the old man looking down at the box, hands resting on the counter.
shots.event: he speaks, quietly, to the box more than to anyone else. On the last few words his eyes come up and to his left, to the person off-screen.
shots.end: the old man looking off to his left, mouth closing, hands still on the counter.

shots.establish: A wide view of the antique shop. A man in a navy hooded parka on the customer side of the wooden counter, hands now empty at his sides. An old man behind the counter in a brown leather apron. A ginger cat on the counter.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The man in the navy parka
silent: The old man
shots.open: the man in the parka half-turned toward the door, stopping.
shots.event: he turns back a little and asks one short question, one hand lifting slightly and dropping again.
shots.end: the man in the parka half-turned, waiting, hand back at his side.

shots.establish: Closer on the old man behind the wooden counter in a brown leather work apron over a green waistcoat, white hair, white beard, round gold glasses. A ginger cat beside him. At the frame edge, a small open walnut box.
shots.camera: is locked off and does not move
shots.speaker: The old man
shots.open: the old man looking off to his left.
shots.event: he answers in four words, already turning his eyes back down to the box before he has finished, entirely unhurried.
shots.end: the old man looking down at the box, mouth closed, hands flat on the counter.

_min_take: minimax H3 will not render below 5s. Short exchanges are shot at 5 and trimmed to cut_to in assembly — shoot the minimum, cut to length.
